# dagsterplus_code_location (Resource)

Manages a Dagster+ code location within a deployment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dagsterplus_code_location" "my_pipeline" {
  deployment = "prod"
  name            = "my-pipeline"
  image           = "ghcr.io/my-org/my-pipeline:latest"

  code_source {
    python_file = "repo.py"
  }

  working_directory = "/app"
  executable_path   = "/usr/bin/python3"
}

# Using a package name instead of a Python file
resource "dagsterplus_code_location" "my_package" {
  deployment = "prod"
  name            = "my-package"
  image           = "ghcr.io/my-org/my-package:latest"

  code_source {
    package_name = "my_dagster_package"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deployment` (String) The name of the deployment this code location belongs to.
- `name` (String) The name of the code location.

### Optional

- `agent_queue` (String) The agent queue to use for this code location.
- `attribute` (String) Python attribute containing the Definitions object.
- `code_source` (Block, Optional) Specifies where Dagster finds the code. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--code_source))
- `executable_path` (String) Path to the Python executable inside the container.
- `git` (Block, Optional) Git-based code location. Exactly one of image or git must be specified. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--git))
- `image` (String) The Docker image to use for this code location. Exactly one of image or git must be specified.
- `working_directory` (String) The working directory inside the container.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier in the form `{deployment}/{name}`.

<a id="nestedblock--code_source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `code_source`

Optional:

- `module_name` (String) Python module name containing the repository. Mutually exclusive with python_file and package_name.
- `package_name` (String) Python package name containing the repository. Mutually exclusive with python_file and module_name.
- `python_file` (String) Path to a Python file containing the repository. Mutually exclusive with package_name and module_name.


<a id="nestedblock--git"></a>
### Nested Schema for `git`

Optional:

- `commit_hash` (String) The git commit hash to use.
- `url` (String) The URL of the git repository.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Code locations are imported using the format: <deployment>/<code_location_name>
terraform import dagsterplus_code_location.example prod/my-pipeline
```
